validation.priceLimit: Price limit must be an exact non-negative credit amount with at most three decimal places.
validation.countLimits: Call and token limits must be canonical integers no greater than 9,000,000,000,000,000.
validation.tokenReserve: Token reserve must be an integer from 0 through 2,147,483,647.
validation.safeNote: Reviewer-safe note must be at most 256 characters and contain no control characters.
validation.reviewReason: Review reason is required and must be at most 1,024 characters.
validation.expiry: Each effective expiry must be a valid supported date or permanent where authorized.
validation.expiryAuthorization: The effective expiry must stay within the donor-authorized limit.
validation.completeSettings: Approval requires a complete setting for every surviving key.
validation.modelIdentity: Provider and model are required, limited to 64 characters, and cannot reuse the [公益] prefix.
validation.modelPrices: Every price must be an exact non-negative credit amount with at most three decimal places.
validation.discountPercent: Discount percent must be an integer from 0 through 100.
validation.discountDates: Discount dates must be valid and the end must be later than the start.
